set_global_params: set Theseus global parameters like so2_norm_eps_float32 or fast_approx_local_jacobians using a dictionary of options
get_eps: get the epsilon tolerance value for a given Lie group type, attribute, and torch dtype
reset_global_params: reset all Theseus global parameters back to their default epsilon values
check_dtype_supported: check whether a given torch dtype is supported by Theseus (float32 or float64 only)
configure_approx_jacobians: configure the fast_approx_local_jacobians flag to enable or disable fast approximate local Jacobian computation
